title: Siebeck--Marden Theorems and Symmetric Parametrizations of Cyclic Polygons
summary: The classical Blaschke-product approach provides an elegant description of triangles inscribed in a circle and circumscribed about an ellipse. Motivated by the Siebeck--Marden theorem, we derive a symmetric parametrization for cyclic $p$-gons circumscribed about a Siebeck--Marden curve of class $p-1$, recovering the Blaschke product parametrization as the triangular case. We then use this parametrization to establish several geometric invariance results, including a characterization of when the sum of the squares of all sides and diagonals is invariant.
